title: Selected work: choose the page structure
question: Craft & Communicate is the only story, and every picture is labeled as illustration. Lock one structure for /work, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: One report's journey
options.thesis: Scroll follows one report down a dotted route: gathered by hand, brought into the platform, sold as the agency's service.
options.viewport: Title and lead at left; at right the route starts at a by-hand workstation and a canary packet travels down toward the platform module.
options.risk: The story is only fully told after scrolling; the first viewport shows the problem more than the result.

options.label: Before and after
options.thesis: One agency diorama with a Before / After control, like the homepage story but about their reporting.
materials: teal live lanes to client desks
options.viewport: Title and lead at left; the agency diorama at right in its after state, lanes running from the platform to client desks, with the toggle above.
options.risk: Closest to the homepage's own device; it proves consistency more than it adds a new idea.

options.label: Three rooms, one route
options.thesis: The whole story in one panorama: by hand, the platform, the agency's clients, joined by one route.
options.viewport: Title and lead across the top; three vignettes left to right with a packet route; the illustration caption below.
options.risk: Three vignettes at once can read as a diagram strip; the center platform has to win the scale contest.
